individual-data-points.explanation: Flow cytometry pseudocolor/scatter plots display individual events directly; no averaged bar/summary statistic requiring overlay of individual points.
Flow cytometry scatter plots showing individual events (CD98 vs CD19, FSC-A vs IgD); scatter plots are exempt as the points are the data.
Flow cytometry scatter/pseudocolor plots (IgM vs IgD, Fas vs NP, CD38 vs CD138) showing individual events; no summary bar chart present.
Color-coded overlay scatter plots (CD62L vs CD44, CD80 vs PD-L2) showing individual cell events for MBC/GC/naive populations; scatter plots are exempt.
Flow cytometry gating scatter plots (CD62L vs CD44, CD80 vs PD-L2) showing individual events; no averaged summary statistic requiring point overlay.

error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: not needed - flow cytometry plots show gated individual events with percentages, no error bars or box-plot elements present.
not needed - no error bars or box/whisker elements in these flow cytometry plots.
not needed - flow cytometry gating plots with percentages only, no error bars present.
not needed - overlay scatter plots showing individual events by color-coded population; no error bars or box-plot elements.
not needed - gating plots with gate percentages only, no error bars present.
